title: Bar Drop Summer Dream 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Summer Dream brings together a vibrant medley of exotic fruits for a truly uplifting tropical vape. The complex profile weaves together the tangy sweetness of Pineapple, the refreshing juiciness of Watermelon, the aromatic depth of Passionfruit, and the bright citrus notes of Orange, all rounded off with rich Mango. The double-concentrated formulation ensures that each distinct tropical note shines through, creating a multi-layered and highly satisfying fruit punch. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid is specifically designed for MTL/RDL vaping. When paired with stater vape kits and low-wattage tanks, it produces small vapour clouds alongside exceptional flavour clarity. The even consistency ensures optimal wicking and performance in MTL/RDL devices, providing a smooth and satisfying experience. The Bar Drop Shortfill collection takes the intensely concentrated flavour profiles typically found in "bar salt" ranges and presents them in a 50%-VG format. Supplied as 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in a 60ml bottle, there is space to add a single 10ml nicotine shot, allowing you to easily create 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. This offers a cost-effective and highly flavoursome solution for sub-ohm vapers.
